response.sql: WITH per_nat AS (SELECT c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT c.constructorId) AS constructor_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, constructor_count, constructor_count - AVG(constructor_count) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM per_nat ORDER BY nationality;

assumptions.assumption: Constructors with no constructorResults rows are excluded, so 'distinct constructors with constructor results' counts only constructors that have at least one results row.
Missing points (NULL) are skipped by SUM, so a nationality whose results all have NULL points shows a NULL total rather than 0.
Constructors with a NULL nationality form their own group and are included in the average across nationalities.
The average is the unweighted mean of the per-nationality distinct-constructor counts, and diff_from_avg is the count minus that average, left unrounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Only constructor results rows with a recorded (non-NULL) points value count, both for the points total and for the distinct-constructor count, and the average is taken over those nationalities.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_nat AS (SELECT c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT c.constructorId) AS constructor_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId WHERE cr.points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, constructor_count, constructor_count - AVG(constructor_count) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM per_nat ORDER BY nationality;
